# Text.PositionOf

```m
Text.PositionOf(text as text, substring as text, optional occurrence as nullable number, optional comparer as nullable function) as any
```

Returns the first position of the value (-1 if not found).

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/text-positionof)

| `substring` | `text` | no |
| `occurrence` | `nullable number` | yes |
| `comparer` | `nullable function` | yes |
